body_text:
For an endomorphism $T$ of a finite-dimensional vector space,
the characteristic polynomial is $\chi_T(t)=\det(tI-T)$. A
scalar $\lambda$ is an eigenvalue exactly when
$\chi_T(\lambda)=0$, equivalently when $T-\lambda I$ has
nontrivial kernel. Eigenvectors are required to be nonzero.
